name: Momo
source:
Momo has not been able to walk and has been constantly weak and ill after an accident, but there is one thing bringing light to her life.

[From [url=https://trc450.itch.io/momo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Momo在一场意外后一直无法行走，身体虚弱多病，但有一件事为她的生活带来了光亮。
